affidavit.description: A sworn statement prepared and commissioned by an authorised commissioner of oaths.
sources: Home Affairs, where the office provides that service
A bank or post office where an authorised commissioner is available
An attorney or other authorised commissioner
affidavit.cost_note: Ask the specific office whether commissioning is free; never pay an unofficial fee. SAPS and some government offices commonly provide commissioning without charge, but private providers may charge for drafting or related services.
notes: The applicant must sign in the commissioner's presence. Do not sign beforehand.

certified_copy_of_id.description: A certified copy of an identity document.
sources: A bank or post office with an authorised commissioner
An attorney or other authorised commissioner
certified_copy_of_id.cost_note: The exact availability and cost can differ by office.
notes: Take the original document with you when getting a certified copy made.

birth_certificate_reissue.description: A replacement or additional birth certificate.
sources: An approved online channel where available
birth_certificate_reissue.cost_note: The required certificate type and current tariff must be confirmed against Home Affairs' current fee schedule.
notes: Do not hard-code a R75 or R20 fee for this service — confirm the current tariff with Home Affairs before quoting a price.

marriage_or_death_certificate_reissue.description: A replacement or additional marriage or death certificate, requested from Home Affairs using the relevant civil-record service.
sources: Home Affairs, using the relevant civil-record service
applicant_provides: Names and details of the people concerned
Marriage or death date, if known
Existing certificate or reference details, if available
Proof of relationship or authority where required
marriage_or_death_certificate_reissue.cost_note: Fee, if applicable, must be confirmed with Home Affairs.

court_order.description: A court order for the matter at hand, from the court that dealt with it.
notes: The relevant court depends on the issue.
Home Affairs cannot normally substitute a private letter for a required court order.

foreign_documents.description: Requirements for documents issued outside South Africa.
requirements: Official translation into an accepted South African language
Verification by the relevant embassy or consulate
notes: The receiving Home Affairs office or South African mission should confirm the exact requirements before travel.
